description: The agent's plan of steps: what it intends to do, reviewed and edited before the run and watched while it runs. In Review mode a step can be renamed inline (F2 or a click on its title, Enter saves, Escape cancels), added below a row or at the end, removed with an Undo strip, and reordered through the core TmSortableList. In Running mode the same rows are read-only, a running step counts its live elapsed time from the injected TimeProvider, the summary adds the plan total ("4 of 7 done · 1:24"), and a failed step shows its error and offers "Retry from this step". The component never mutates Steps: every edit raises OnPlanChanged(newSteps, edit) and the host applies it.

examples.title: Review a plan and start the run
examples.code:
<TmAgentPlan Steps="@steps"
             OnPlanChanged="ApplyAsync"
             OnApprove="ApproveAsync"
             OnRun="RunAsync" />

@code {
    private IReadOnlyList<AgentPlanStep> steps = [
        new("Draft the outline"),
        new("Confirm the sources"),
        new("Publish the summary"),
    ];

    private Task ApplyAsync(IReadOnlyList<AgentPlanStep> next, AgentPlanEdit edit)
    {
        steps = next; // the host owns the plan; the component only proposes
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }
}

examples.title: Watch the run, with a retry from the failed step
Read-only review that may only be approved

parameters.name: Steps
parameters.description: The plan, in display order. The component renders exactly this list (plus the inline rename editor) and never writes back to it: every edit is reported through OnPlanChanged, so a host that ignores the callback keeps the plan it passed. Null renders the empty state.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Whether the plan is being reviewed or is running. Default AgentPlanMode.Review. A Running plan is read-only — no rename, no add, no remove, no reorder and no Approve / Run — but it keeps the live timer of a running step, the summary, a failed step's error and its Retry action.

parameters.name: OnPlanChanged
parameters.description: Raised once per edit with the WHOLE proposed step list and the AgentPlanEdit that produced it. The component does not apply the edit itself; the host stores the list and the next render shows it. Not raised for a rename that changed nothing, for a refused empty title, or for a reorder that did not move a row.

parameters.name: OnApprove
parameters.description: Raised when the reader approves the plan. The action is rendered only when this callback is bound, so a plan without a host decision has no dead button. Review mode only.

parameters.name: OnRun
parameters.description: Raised when the reader starts the run. Rendered only when this callback is bound. Review mode only — a running plan offers no second start.

parameters.name: OnRetryFrom
parameters.description: Raised with the failed step whose Retry the reader chose: the host restarts the run FROM that step (the steps before it keep their state). Available in both modes, because a failure is reported while the run is going.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: The heading above the plan. Null renders the localized default ("Plan"). The heading is not rendered when ShowTitle is false.

parameters.name: ShowTitle
parameters.description: Whether the heading is rendered. Default true; set false when the host page already provides the section heading. The plan stays named through AriaLabel either way.

parameters.name: HeadingLevel
parameters.description: The heading level of the rendered title, clamped to 2–6. Default 3, so the plan can sit under any page outline; the level has no effect when ShowTitle is false.

parameters.name: ShowSummary
parameters.description: Whether the "4 of 7 done · 1:24" summary is rendered next to the title. Default true; the summary is the only place the plan's whole progress and total elapsed time are stated.

parameters.name: AllowEditing
parameters.description: Whether the plan may be edited at all. Default true — and only meaningful in AgentPlanMode.Review, because a running plan is read-only regardless. Set false for a review that may only be read and approved.

parameters.name: EmptyContent
parameters.description: Rendered instead of the localized "No steps yet." when Steps is null or empty. The plan's instructions and its live region stay rendered either way.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: The accessible name of the plan. Null names it by the rendered heading — so the name a reader hears is the one they see — and, without a heading, by the localized "Agent plan".

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.
